metaDescription: Order a hand-drawn custom South Park portrait from your photo. Preview within 72 hours, unlimited free revisions, and digital or print options.
heroHeading: Turn Your Crew Into Original Cartoon Characters
description: Bring your group chat, family, partner, or pets into a playful South Park-inspired world with a custom south park portrait drawn by a human artist. We use the visual language fans love—flat shapes, bold outlines, simple expressions, colorful winter clothing, and snowy town-inspired settings—while turning you into original characters rather than copying or impersonating copyrighted characters. The result is a funny, recognisable keepsake built around your real personalities.

South Park minimalism makes the details count. Hair color, hats, jacket colors, facial expressions, and height order help everyone read instantly, so send a clear photo and tell us who is who. Straight-on group photos work especially well, but we can combine reference images for couples, friend groups, families, coworkers, and pets. Want a specific gag, background, sign, or outfit? Add it to your notes and our artist will work it into the composition.

Your custom south park portrait is hand-drawn by a human artist, never produced by an automated filter. You’ll receive a preview within 72 hours of ordering, with unlimited free revisions so the likeness, joke, and character details feel right before completion. Choose a digital artwork or an available print option, then make it a memorable gift for a fan. For more inspiration, explore our [South Park-inspired custom poster guide](/blog/south-park-inspired-custom-poster), browse [gift ideas for South Park fans](/blog/best-gifts-for-south-park-fans), or see the full range of [hand-drawn portrait styles](/).

faqs.q: Where can I order a custom South Park portrait from a photo, and how do I commission an artist?
faqs.a: You can order one directly from Anime Cabinet by uploading your photo, selecting your preferred options, and adding creative instructions at checkout. A human artist creates your South Park-inspired original character, then sends a preview within 72 hours. You can request unlimited free revisions until the people, pets, clothing, and joke details feel right.

faqs.q: How much does a custom South Park portrait cost, and can it be a gift?
faqs.a: Custom South Park portraits start at $39.99, with the final price depending on your selected portrait options. Yes—this makes a memorable gift for birthdays, holidays, couples, friend groups, roommates, and office teams. Anime Cabinet is a strong choice for custom South Park portraits when you want human-drawn artwork, fast preview delivery, and revisions instead of an automatic filter.
